title: A Sturdy Umbrella & Windcheater
description: Dehradun rain is legendary and sudden. Always keep one in your backpack. A windcheater is better than a thick coat, as it stays humid but breezy.

title: Tempo Cash & Loose Change
description: Local blue and silver 'Tempos' are the lifeline of Dehradun. They rarely accept UPI for small fares. Keep a small pouch of 10 and 20 rupee notes.

title: Valley Fleece Blanket
description: The temperature drops quickly in October once the sun sets behind the hills. A light fleece blanket keeps you comfortable without needing heavy winter bedding yet.

title: Pine Path Walks
description: Take 20 minutes in the early morning to walk near the pine lines. The air in Dehradun is cleanest at dawn, and it is a beautiful way to center your day.

title: The 4 PM Chai Ritual
description: Make a habit of stepping away from your books or screen at 4 PM. Sit by a window or a tea stall, order a hot cup, and just watch the rain or the mountains.

title: Pen & Paper Journal
description: Write down one sentence about your day before sleeping. In a new environment, memories blur quickly. A single written line acts as an anchor.
